script: A confident answer can still be wrong. Before you trust a claim, follow it back to its source. Check what the original actually says, not just the summary. If the evidence is missing, leave the gap visible instead of filling it with a guess. Then make your decision. Useful AI should help you understand the answer—not just make it sound convincing.
audience: People who use AI for work, research, and everyday decisions.
rationale: User rejected sparse desk diagram. Follow the authorized treatment with eleven evolving compositions, one focal meaning plus overlapping reaction, living motion, captions and physical sound.
metaphor: A theatrically confident paper claim must survive a trip through its source and missing support; a guess cannot repair the hole.

limitations: Agent-authored directed reset; not evidence of autonomous high-energy creative planning.
Finite paper-world bindings, not arbitrary-script generation.
New voice delivery and sound design require human listening review.
